selection: maximum synthetic common dev micro NER F1; first checkpoint wins ties
D1: Frozen V1 train only, diagnostic source/template dependence retained
D2: Canonical documentary style: literal excerpts plus synthetic documentary cases
D3: Canonical synthetic oral only; small technical diagnostic
D4: All canonical train observations, natural sampling
D4W: All canonical train; oral observations sampled twice per epoch
D5: Not evaluable: no authorized human transcription training records
test_policy: No frozen test prediction, selection, annotation or derived example
